"""Freeze all V166 array reductions before final training/quality exists."""
import ast
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic'); root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V166-common-support-routing-v2'
assert not (root/'train-result-v1.json').exists() and not (root/'scores-v1.json').exists()
scope=('All four fixed V166 endpoints;identical124909-parameter/47-tensor V165 heads/data/init/loss values/weights/optimizer/inference. '
 'Both common weight1/unit16DN16,difference floor2/weight1/epsilon.003,flat anchor.25. Only common-loss derivative holds support fixed in candidate;other losses train support normally. '
 'Surrogate adjoint,not finite-difference derivative. Exact V165 control. Historical contrasts mix interventions;adaptive related cohort,not independent scenes/significance. '
 'All cases/worst increases retained. Actual native viewing only after original-detail inspection;both protected scenes/priors/windows/JPEGs,ISO100 qualitative refs,notGT. Eight retained native columns. '
 'Failed v1 complex telemetry preserved;v2 fixes magnitude RMS.56 parity roots/20leaf checks adopted,3 discarded prefix roots/12images counted separately;no full-training restart.')
def names(s):
 return (s.replace('V165-pair-common-v1','V166-common-support-routing-v2')
  .replace('fine-control','common-control').replace('pair-common','routed-common')
  .replace('Fine ctrl raw','Common ctrl raw').replace('Fine ctrl EMA','Common ctrl EMA')
  .replace('Pair common raw','Routed common raw').replace('Pair common EMA','Routed common EMA'))
sources=[]
for stem in ['summarize','build','paired','quiet-dc','record','route','compare','review']:
 old={'summarize':'summarize-v165-final-v1.py','build':'build-v165-tables-v1.py','paired':'paired-v165-regions-v1.py',
  'quiet-dc':'quiet-dc-v165-final-v1.py','record':'record-v165-viewing-v1.py','route':'route-v165-final-v1.py',
  'compare':'compare-v165-retained-v1.py','review':'review-v165-effects-v1.py'}[stem]
 s=names((repo/'.cache'/old).read_text())
 if stem in ['paired','record','compare','review']:
  prefix="        'scope':" if stem=='record' else "    'scope':"
  a=s.index(prefix);b=s.index('\n',a);s=s[:a]+prefix+repr(scope)+'})'+s[b:]
 if stem=='compare':
  needle="    'V164':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V164-pair-unit-floor-v1','fine-pair'),";assert needle in s
  s=s.replace(needle,needle+"\n    'V165':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V165-pair-common-v1','pair-common'),")
 p=repo/'.cache'/old.replace('v165','v166');assert not p.exists();ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
s=names((repo/'.cache/audit-v165-training-units-v1.py').read_text()).replace('through V164','through V165')
p=repo/'.cache/audit-v166-training-units-v1.py';assert not p.exists();ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
s=names((repo/'.cache/audit-v165-training-objective-v1.py').read_text())
s=s.replace("if name=='common-control' or not paired:assert c['pair_common_error']==0", "if not paired:assert c['pair_common_error']==0")
s=s.replace("   if ADC:assert actual==c['gradient_norm']==0", "   assert c['common_support_detached']==bool(arm['common_detach_support'] and paired)\n   assert 0<=c['support_mean']<=1 and np.isfinite(c['spectral_delta_RMS']) and c['spectral_delta_RMS']>=0\n   if ADC:assert actual==c['gradient_norm']==0")
s=s.replace("'common_error':c['pair_common_error'],", "'common_error':c['pair_common_error'],'common_support_detached':c['common_support_detached'],")
s=s.replace("'common_supervised_batches':sum", "'fixed_support_batches':sum(v['common_support_detached'] for v in items),\n  'common_supervised_batches':sum")
s=s.replace('Confirms actual weight0/1 and conditional routing','Confirms actual weight1 in both arms and conditional fixed-support routing')
s=s.replace('CPU/CUDA checks and12-call retained-output diagnostic','CPU/CUDA checks and4-call/eight-parameter-adjoint retained diagnostic')
p=repo/'.cache/audit-v166-training-objective-v1.py';assert not p.exists();ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
s=names((repo/'.cache/audit-v165-archived-support-v1.py').read_text()).replace('v165-archived-support','v166-archived-support')
s=s.replace('Post-hoc reduction','Predeclared reduction').replace('completed-posthoc-archived','completed-predeclared-archived')
s=s.replace('Post-hoc diagnostic after observed response loss.','Predeclared diagnostic of support and direct RGB activity. This reduction was frozen before final quality existed.')
p=repo/'.cache/audit-v166-archived-support-v1.py';assert not p.exists();ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
assert len(sources)==11
snapshot=root/'protocol-document-v1.md';assert not snapshot.exists();shutil.copyfile(repo/'docs/common-support-routing.md',snapshot)
receipt=root/'final-helper-preparation-v1.json';assert not receipt.exists()
save(receipt,{'status':'fixed-before-trained-quality','sources':sources,'protocol_snapshot':ref(snapshot),
 'scope':scope,'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
public=repo/'docs/results/v166-final-helper-preparation-v1.json';assert not public.exists()
save(public,{'status':'fixed-before-trained-quality','preparation':ref(receipt),'source_texts':[dict(v,text=Path(v['path']).read_text()) for v in sources],
 'preparer':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
 'expected_actual_objective_checks':2000,'expected_unit_records':1000,'expected_unit_fingerprints':2000,'inherited_mask_records':1000,
 'expected_current_paired_entries':3264,'expected_retained_versions':11,'expected_retained_paired_entries':39424,
 'expected_retained_mean_cells':3256,'expected_score_table_cells':205,'actual_native_viewing_required':True,'scope':scope})
print('Frozen11 V166 final helpers before final quality;11 retained versions')
